## Clipto MCP

Launching today

Let agents source clips from terabytes of your local video

Clipto MCP gives Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents the ability to source clips and more from inside the videos, photos, and audio recordings stored on your computer. Instead of manually browsing files, simply describe what you need. For example, turn a script into a video by matching each sentence with your local footage; find every scene where someone mentioned a topic; create rough cuts; or search years of media as if you have a dedicated assistant editor.

[...] If you've ever found it tedious and time-consuming to type out all your feedback to an agent, including screenshots in the right places, and copy-paste relevant browser logs, well, there's a way better way now. I just open-sourced an app I use this for called Clips. Clips just lets you hit record and start talking. It captures everything on your screen as well as browser logs, redacting sensitive information. And when done, you just get a URL and just paste the URL to your agent. Clips is an agent-native app, which means just from the URL, the agent can discover APIs to grab any information it needs. Transcript, screenshots of various timestamps, the browser logs at those timestamps, etc. These videos are human-shareable, too.
